# Vendored code

`preact-htm.js` is `htm/preact/standalone.module.js` from htm 3.1.1, which bundles Preact 10.29.8. It is committed unchanged.
The licenses (MIT and Apache-2.0) are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

To update it: run `npm i preact htm` in an empty folder, copy `node_modules/htm/preact/standalone.module.js` here, and update the
versions in this file and in the notices.
